Apply only if meet the requirements below by emailing hello AT sprect DOT com.


Office location: Andheri West, Mumbai (only Mumbai residents can apply)


Duration: Full time opportunity / 10:30 AM 7 PM Mon-Fri / Flexible


Requirement: As a frontend developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and implementing high-quality front-end code for our web application. The ideal candidate is a creative thinker, problem solver and comfortable with learning new skills on-the-go.


Key responsibilities:

Design and develop high-performance, reusable, and maintainable UI components using React.js, Next.js and Redux best practices.

Translate Figma designs into clean & efficient React code, ensuring pixel-perfect implementation.

Implement features & functionalities according to user stories and technical specifications.

Collaborate with back-end developers and designers to ensure seamless integration and user experience.

Able to thoroughly test and implement changes.

Self-driven and motivated to learn new skills & take ownership of the codebase.


Prerequisites:

2+ years of professional experience in frontend development with extensive use of React.js, Next.js and Redux

Proficient in HTML5 and CSS3.

Proficient in JavaScript, including DOM manipulation and the JavaScript object model.

Proven ability to write clean, modular, and well-documented code.

Proficient in Git for version control and collaboration.

Experience with UI/UX design principles.

Experience with API integrations and data fetching techniques (RESTful).

Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate development, debug code, and solve problems. We expect you to leverage these as part of your workflow.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Why you will love working at Sprect:

You will get to work at an early stage start-up, to build the business, and to have an outsized impact on our company and society.

Opportunity to work with experienced founding team.

Opportunity to try your hand at new things.

Elevate your profile; acquire essential skills in entrepreneurship and building a robust SaaS product.

Competitive salary + ESOP.


Sprect helps people book trusted 1:1 video conversations with experienced professionals across industries. Private. Structured. Direct.
Stay updated. No spam.
Short updates on new professionals, features, and partnerships.

jobs_results.description: Company Description Wafynet is a technology-driven company focused on building modern web applications and digital solutions for a diverse range of clients. The team emphasizes clean architecture, scalable systems, and user-centered design to deliver reliable and maintainable products. Wafynet encourages continuous learning, collaboration, and the adoption of current industry best practices. The company offers opportunities to work on impactful projects with modern JavaScript frameworks and cloud technologies. Team members are supported in advancing their technical expertise and leadership capabilities. Role Description The Senior Software Engineer (React.js Developer) role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune Division. This role involves designing and developing complex front-end features using React.js, integrating them with back-end services, and ensuring high performance and responsiveness of web applications. The engineer will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other developers to translate requirements into clean, testable, and maintainable code. Day-to-day responsibilities include code reviews, optimization, troubleshooting, and participation in architecture discussions, as well as mentoring junior engineers and contributing to best practices and standards. The role also includes working with modern tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems to support efficient development and deployment processes. Qualifications - Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. - Experience in Software Development and Programming with JavaScript/TypeScript, focusing on React.js and related front-end ecosystems. - Knowledge of Back-End Web Development concepts and integration with APIs and microservices. - Proficiency in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and familiarity with design patterns and modular architectures. - Hands-on experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux), modern build tools, and RESTful or GraphQL APIs. - Ability to write clean, testable code and use unit/integration testing frameworks. - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and collaborative development workflows. - Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - Strong problem-solving skills, effective communication, and the ability to guide and mentor team members. - Experience in performance optimization, accessibility, and secure coding practices for web applications is an advantage. .
